mechanism: Enalapril may reduce renal perfusion and glomerular filtration, potentially increasing atovaquone accumulation and toxicity, while atovaquone absorption may be affected by GI pH changes; both drugs can cause hyperkalemia through different mechanisms.
action: Monitor renal function, potassium levels, and atovaquone efficacy; maintain adequate hydration; consider alternative antimicrobial if renal impairment develops.
